entry.title: Request tracking guide
entry.why: Coordinate several requests toward one outcome.
entry.status: Authored method; no ticket connection or monitor is installed

briefing.purpose: Coordinate several requests toward one outcome.
briefing.inputs: Outcome, request IDs/links, owners and dated status evidence.
briefing.approach: Track dependencies and distinguish administrative closure from observed completion.
briefing.outputs: Small request tracker, blocker summary and follow-up drafts.
briefing.requirements: Supplied snapshots or an authorized source connection.
briefing.limits: Stale observations stay dated; sending and scheduled checks are separate capabilities and actions.
briefing.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.

use_cases.title: Check what closed actually means
use_cases.outcome: A distinction between recorded status and evidence that the requested outcome occurred.

links.why: Apply the guide while tracing related records and drafting a specific follow-up.
